commit_scope: The root cause of today's outage, reproduced in a probe build of b9527a577 and healed: the kernel bridge's candidate list did not name the image's kernel root, so with #4117's whole source home (/app/form/form/form-stdlib) every candidate missed and fkwu ran from `/`; the bridge now names /app/form, and the contract test holds the image's layout and the three layouts the bridge must answer.
evidence_refs: Probe on the VPS (image of b9527a577 built under the tag probe-b95, never deployed): inside it `/app/form/form-stdlib` is absent and `/app/form/form/form-stdlib/core.fk` present; from /app/form a BML program with `// preludes: form/form-stdlib/core.fk` answers 0 and `scripts/fkwu_run.sh --src anonymous_trace_query.bml` prints the SQL; `python -c 'import app.services.anonymous_meeting_trace_service'` still fails with `BML contract source unavailable: form/form-stdlib/core.fk`. So the bridge was not running fkwu from /app/form.

Read in api/app/services/form_kernel_bridge.py: `_REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent.parent` — the repo root in a checkout (api/app/services → repo), but `/` inside the image, where the module sits at /app/app/services. `_form_source_parent()` tried /app, / and /form for a `form/form-stdlib` child; before #4117 /app matched (the stdlib lay flat at /app/form/form-stdlib); after it nothing matched and the function fell back to `/`, so fkwu resolved the prelude as /form/form-stdlib/core.fk.

Heal: `/app/form` (the image's kernel root) is named among the candidates; the docstring says why the repo-root arithmetic cannot stand for it. test_kernel_bridge_runs_fkwu_from_the_image_kernel_root stages the whole source home, the earlier flat layout and a checkout under tmp_path and asserts the bridge's answer for each; the Dockerfile assertions follow #4117's layout (form/runtime → /app/form/runtime, the stdlib under /app/form/form/form-stdlib). tests/test_api_dockerfile_contract.py: 13 passed.

Live between the two heals: after #4122 rolled out (api healthy, 0 tracebacks) /api/health and /api/ready answered 404 — #4117 moved them to the native container and left the route published pending. Applied the body's own door from a clean checkout of main: deployment_compose_care.bml, mode observe (plan idempotent, native rule carries /api/health, /api/ready, /api/pulse/*, /api/substrate/*, /api/ideas, /api/graph/nodes), then activate ["native-api"] → status applied. Edge after: /api/health 200 and /api/ready 200 from runtime fkwu, /api/ping 200, /api/news/feed 200, witness with every organ breathing (09:49 UTC).

The Hostinger run for #4122 reports failure only because its post-rollout public check hit /api/health during the window before the native route was activated; the VPS log reads `Deploy complete (3181b92eec42)`.
